name: file.delete
description: Delete a file or empty directory. Hard delete — bypasses Recycle Bin / Trash. Makes something cease to be — classified D.

recursive.description: If path is a directory, delete its contents recursively. Without this flag, deleting a non-empty directory returns ERR not_empty.

windows-modern.description: DeleteFileW for files, RemoveDirectoryW for directories. Hard delete — does not route through the Recycle Bin.

windows-classic.description: DeleteFileA / DeleteFileW depending on NT version, plus RemoveDirectory. Same hard-delete behaviour — Recycle Bin requires SHFileOperation, which the agent intentionally does not use.
